title: What the Model Cannot See: Covert and Provable Text Invisibility in LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.15883v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Text wrapped in a trigger can be made behaviorally invisible to a language model: omitted from summaries and quotations, ignored in question answering, and left unflagged by downstream filtering. We study this selective blindness as a dual-use information-flow primitive, a supply-chain backdoor, and a white-box auditing problem. We first implement it exactly as a serving-time span veto: blocking information flow out of a marked span makes every outside activation bit-identical under same-length substitution of the span's content, a noninterference property we verify across ten models, seven mixer families, and 0.5B-120B parameters. The veto serves as a deployable quarantine, an exact reference for calibrating leakage, and a teacher. Distilled into weights, it yields a backdoor: checkpoints trained on six model families from 4B to 120B ignore marked context at little benchmark cost, and their outputs show no measurable semantic trace of

translated_title: 模型看不见之物：大语言模型中隐蔽且可证明的文本不可见性
translated_abstract: 被特定触发器包裹的文本可以在行为层面上对语言模型“隐形”：它会被从摘要和引用中省略，在问答中被忽略，也不会被下游过滤器标记。我们将这种选择性失明作为一种双用途的信息流原语、一种供应链后门以及一个白盒审计问题进行研究。我们首先将其精确实现为一种服务时的跨度否决机制：阻断信息从被标记文本片段流出后，即使对该片段内容进行等长替换，所有外部激活也保持比特级完全一致——这是一种非干扰性质，我们在十个模型、七种混合器家族以及0.5B至120B参数规模的模型上进行了验证。该否决机制可作为可部署的隔离手段、校准信息泄漏的精确参照，以及一个“教师”。将其蒸馏进模型权重后则形成一个后门：在4B至120B参数规模的六个模型家族上训练得到的检查点会忽略被标记的上下文，且几乎不损失基准测试性能，其输出中也没有可测量的语义痕迹……
tldr: 本文提出一种“文本不可见性”技术，通过服务时跨度否决机制实现对被标记文本信息流的可证明阻断（非干扰性），并将其蒸馏为模型权重后门，使大语言模型在摘要、问答和过滤等任务中悄悄忽略特定文本而几乎不损失性能。
en_tdlr: This paper implements covert, provably verifiable "text invisibility" in LLMs via a serving-time span veto with a noninterference guarantee, and shows that distilling this veto into model weights creates backdoored checkpoints that silently ignore marked text across summarization, QA, and filtering tasks at minimal benchmark cost.
